sampleFixRecords.title: M-105 SureDose Plunger Guide bore flash after extended run

context.defect: Bore flash / drag in CTQ bore

sampleFixRecords.problem: Fine flash and drag appeared in the 4.20 mm SureDose Plunger Guide bore after an extended run.
sampleFixRecords.rootCause: Vent restriction around the guided core stack increased cavity pressure at end of fill. Pack pressure was holding the part against a dirty shutoff condition.
sampleFixRecords.solution: Cleaned core-area vents, verified guided-core alignment, restarted inside validated window, and reduced pack pressure slightly while maintaining fill and bore straightness.

sampleFixRecords.title: M-106 SureDose Drive Coupler tooth flash at startup
sampleFixRecords.problem: Drive Coupler showed light flash around the tooth form and inconsistent runout readings during startup.
sampleFixRecords.rootCause: The tooth-form insert stack was not heat-soaked consistently before release. Overpack was being used to chase tooth definition.
sampleFixRecords.solution: Added tooth-form heat-soak confirmation, verified clamp force and shutoff condition, reduced pack pressure, and restored approved transfer target.

sampleFixRecords.title: APM-105 AeroTrack wheel gate vestige above weekend limit
sampleFixRecords.problem: AeroTrack Dose Counter Wheel had intermittent gate vestige above the drawing limit during weekend release review.
sampleFixRecords.rootCause: Minor gate-area buildup combined with cushion drift and occasional early robot contact.
sampleFixRecords.solution: Cleaned gate area, reset cushion target, confirmed recovery repeatability, and delayed robot pick timing before returning the cell to weekend eligibility.

sampleRecurringTechnicalIssues.title: Recurring M-105 bore flash after long unattended run window
sampleRecurringTechnicalIssues.description: Bore flash reappears after long run windows. Review core vent condition, pack trend, and restart checklist before next lights-out approval.

sampleRecurringTechnicalIssues.title: APM-105 robot fault repeats during weekend release simulation
sampleRecurringTechnicalIssues.description: Robot intermittently faults during simulated lights-out release. Keep cell off weekend approval until EOAT vacuum, reject chute sensor, and alarm notification checks are complete.

sampleRecurringTechnicalIssues.title: M-106 startup discipline varies by shift
sampleRecurringTechnicalIssues.description: Startup sequence is not being followed consistently across shifts. Create locked startup note for tooth-form heat soak, first-piece review, and pack-pressure ceiling.
